audit_items.proof_trace: JWT authenticates the Engine API channel but CL does not independently verify EL-provided block hash correctness. CL trusts EL's INVALID_BLOCK_HASH status without computing hash(payload) to confirm payload.block_hash matches payload contents, violating the semi-trusted verification requirement.
audit_items.attack_scenario: If EL is compromised (despite valid JWT), attacker sends payload with mismatched block_hash field. EL returns VALID status. CL accepts without independent hash verification, causing consensus layer to commit invalid block hash.
